entries.title: John 18:1
segments: When Jesus had said this, he went out with his disciples and crossed the brook Kedron to a place where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples went.

entries.title: John 18:2
segments: The place was well known to Judas, the betrayer, for Jesus and his disciples had often met there.

entries.title: John 18:3
segments: So Judas, who had obtained the soldiers of the Roman garrison, and some police-officers from the Chief Priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.

entries.title: John 18:4
segments: Jesus, aware of all that was coming upon him, went to meet them, and said to them: "For whom are you looking?"

entries.title: John 18:5
segments: "Jesus of Nazareth," was their answer. "I am he," said Jesus. (Judas, the betrayer, was also standing with them.)

entries.title: John 18:6
segments: When Jesus said 'I am he,' they drew back and fell to the ground.

entries.title: John 18:7
segments: So he again asked for whom they were looking, and they answered: "Jesus of Nazareth."

entries.title: John 18:8
segments: "I have already told you that I am he," replied Jesus, "so, if it is for me that you are looking, let these men go."

entries.title: John 18:9
segments: This was in fulfillment of his words--'Of those whom thou hast given me I have not lost one.'

entries.title: John 18:10
segments: At this, Simon Peter, who had a sword with him, drew it, and struck the High Priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.

entries.title: John 18:11
segments: But Jesus said to Peter: "Sheathe your sword. Shall I not drink the cup which the Father has given me?"

entries.title: John 18:12
segments: So the soldiers of the garrison, with their Commanding Officer and the Jewish police, arrested Jesus and bound him,

entries.title: John 18:13
segments: And took him first of all to Annas. Annas was the father-in- law of Caiaphas, who was High Priest that year.

entries.title: John 18:14
segments: It was Caiaphas who had counseled the Jews, that it was best that one man should die for the people.

entries.title: John 18:15
segments: Meanwhile Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple. That disciple, being well-known to the High Priest, went with Jesus into the High Priest's court-yard,

entries.title: John 18:16
segments: While Peter stood outside by the door. Presently the other disciple--the one well-known to the High Priest--went out and spoke to the portress, and brought Peter in.

entries.title: John 18:17
segments: So the maidservant said to Peter: "Are not you also one of this man's disciples?" "No, I am not," he said.

entries.title: John 18:18
segments: The servants and police-officers were standing round a char- coal fire (which they had made because it was cold), and were warming themselves. Peter, too, was with them, standing and warming himself.

entries.title: John 18:19
segments: The High Priest questioned Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.

entries.title: John 18:20
segments: "For my part," answered Jesus, "I have spoken to all the world openly. I always taught in some Synagogue, or in the Temple Courts, places where all the Jews assemble, and I never spoke of anything in secret.

entries.title: John 18:21
segments: Why question me? Question those who have listened to me as to what I have spoken about to them. They must know what I said."

entries.title: John 18:22
segments: When Jesus said this, one of the police-officers, who was standing near, gave him a blow with his hand. "Do you answer the High Priest like that?" he exclaimed.

entries.title: John 18:23
segments: "If I said anything wrong, give evidence about it," replied Jesus; "but if not, why do you strike me?"

entries.title: John 18:24
segments: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas the High Priest.

entries.title: John 18:25
segments: Meanwhile Simon Peter was standing there, warming himself; so they said to him: "Are not you also one of his disciples?" Peter denied it. "No, I am not," he said.

entries.title: John 18:26
segments: One of the High Priest's servants, a relation of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, exclaimed: "Did not I myself see you with him in the garden?"

entries.title: John 18:27
segments: Peter again denied it; and at that moment a cock crowed.

entries.title: John 18:28
segments: From Caiaphas they took Jesus to the Government House. It was early in the morning. But they did not enter the Government House themselves, lest they should become 'defiled,' and so be unable to eat the Passover.

entries.title: John 18:29
segments: Therefore Pilate came outside to speak to them. "What charge do you bring against this man?" he asked.

entries.title: John 18:30
segments: "If he had not been a criminal, we should not have given him up to you," they answered.

entries.title: John 18:31
segments: "Take him yourselves," said Pilate, "and try him by your own Law." "We have no power to put any one to death," the Jews replied- -

entries.title: John 18:32
segments: In fulfillment of what Jesus had said when indicating the death that he was destined to die.

entries.title: John 18:33
segments: After that, Pilate went into the Government House again, and calling Jesus up, asked him: "Are you the King of the Jews?"

entries.title: John 18:34
segments: "Do you ask me that yourself?" replied Jesus, "or did others say it to you about me?"

entries.title: John 18:35
segments: "Do you take me for a Jew?" was Pilate's answer. "It is your own nation and the Chief Priests who have given you up to me. What have you done?"

entries.title: John 18:36
segments: "My kingly power," replied Jesus, "is not due to this world. If it had been so, my servants would be doing their utmost to prevent my being given up to the Jews; but my kingly power is not from the world."

entries.title: John 18:37
segments: "So you are a King after all!" exclaimed Pilate. "Yes, it is true I am a King," answered Jesus. "I was born for this, I have come into the world for this--to bear testimony to the Truth. Every one who is on the side of Truth listens to my voice."

entries.title: John 18:38
segments: "What is Truth?" exclaimed Pilate. After saying this, he went out to the Jews again, and said: "For my part, I find nothing with which he can be charged.

entries.title: John 18:39
segments: It is, however, the custom for me to grant you the release of one man at the Passover Festival. Do you wish for the release of the King of the Jews?"

entries.title: John 18:40
segments: "No, not this man," they shouted again, "but Barabbas!" This Barabbas was a robber.
